note: Stability and temporal-map analyses use dates re-aligned to the first date; everything else uses the loader output. Preview values are 8-bit display brightness (0-1), not calibrated backscatter. Relative patterns and timing are meaningful; absolute values are not.

flooded_vegetation.rule: HH rose by >0.10 vs first date (3x3 mean, after removing per-date stable-pixel offset) while HV rose by <0.05; pixel not water-like on first date
